prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Your Pet's Voice & Personality", "Select traits and testing audio samples before bringing your desktop companion to life.", "Personality Trait", "Preview Voice Sample"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is active on your screen! Drag to move, right-click for options, or press Ctrl+Pet to summon.", "Start Interacting", "Desktop Controls Preview"]
2: ["Signing in automatically restores all your previously adopted pets and cloud progress."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "While your pet renders, try out desktop controls in this preview sandbox below.", "Desktop Sandbox Practice", "Tips for managing desktop overlay windows"]
4: ["Custom Pet Photo Studio", "Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Select Photo File", "3D Render Guidelines Preview"]
5: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select between instant adoptable pets or generate a custom AI desktop companion."]
6: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet", "Setting up desktop overlay permissions and high-resolution rendering.", "Display Mode Verified", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion now to unlock the Starter Desktop Toy Pack & Badge!", "Includes Free Starter Accessory Pack"]
8: ["Set Quick Desktop Shortcuts", "Configure simple hotkeys to quickly minimize, interact with, or summon your pet on top of other windows.", "Finish Setup", "Shortcut configuration list"]
9: ["Adopt Ready Companion or Create Custom Pet", "Pick an instant pre-made companion ( ready in 5s ) or upload photos to craft your own unique custom pet."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and rewards for completing an action.
